svg.aria-label: What each phase of the pipeline actually holds, and what is measured on it
svg.title: Objects of study, phase by phase
svg.text: Each phase holds a different kind of thing. What it is, and what we measure on it.
Same fold. Same ligand. Different answer.
Bind the first one and not the others, and the whole chain has to see
a difference that a 2D fingerprint throws away.

g.text: weights, and do they hold up
a score, with an interval on it
